title: Do not swim in the Tungabhadra or Sanapur Lake
body: Currents, deep pools and submerged rocks make the river and reservoir dangerous for swimming. Coracle rides and ferry crossings are suspended when the water is high; follow operator and police instructions.

title: Extreme daytime heat
body: Afternoon temperatures in March to May often approach or exceed 38°C and many sites have little shade. Visit open-air sites early or late, rest indoors at midday and carry water.

title: Monsoon river levels
body: During the monsoon the river can rise quickly after rain or dam releases; ferries and coracles may stop without notice and riverside paths can flood.

title: Avoid isolated hills and trails after dark
body: Hill trails such as Matanga Hill are unlit and rocky. Climb in daylight, preferably in a group, and come down before dark.

title: Monkeys around temples
body: Monkeys are common around temples and hills. Keep food and plastic bags out of sight and do not feed them.
